desc: Establish the batch-order formulation: total cost equals inversions between different-valued elements plus the number of monochromatic batches/runs.
Demonstrate that the current greedy adjacent-exchange solver is incorrect; it fails the supplied samples, including the alternating case.
Derive an exact polynomial-time optimization algorithm via a fundamentally different approach; do not continue refining the failed local-greedy exchange strategy.
Prove the derived algorithm handles cases where temporarily zero- or positive-cost swaps are necessary.
Exhaustively compare the derived algorithm with exact brute-force search on all short sequences, including alternating, nested, and random cases.
Implement the proven algorithm and verify it on the supplied samples and full constraint limits.
